TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 1 
 Transfer policy for Cadre of Social Security Assistants, 2022  
1. Introduction: 
1.1.     This policy may be called “Transfer Policy for Cadre of Social Security 
Assistants, 2022” hereinafter, referred to as TP-SSA. 
1.2.     TP-SSA shall be applicable to all Social Security Assistants (SSA) including 
the Senior Social Security Assistants (SSSA). 
1.3.     SSA/SSSA postings shall be governed on the following key principles:- 
1.3.1.    All SSA/ SSSA are liable to serve anywhere in the respective States to 
which they are appointed. 
1.3.2.     Notwithstanding the above, any SSA/SSSA may be transferred from one 
State to another State or to Headquarters or vice-versa on administrative 
grounds or in public interest. 
1.4.     It shall cover all the SSA/SSSA posted at District, Special State, Regional and 
any other office.  
1.5.     This policy supersedes the existing guidelines for transfer or rotation or Inter 
Regional (State) Transfer for the cadre of SSA as amended from time to time. 
1.6.     The Policy is in response to the direction of the Supreme Court of India as 
contained in the Writ Petition (Civil) No.82 of 2011(T.S.R Subramanian & ORS. Vs. 
Union of India & Ors. Judgement dated 31.10.2013) and the communications from 
the Department of Personnel & Training bearing number 11013/10/2013-Estt.A 
dated December 26, 2013, January 09, 2014 , June 13, 2014 as well July 2, 2015. 
1.7.     The policy borrows various provisions and contours from the current 
guidelines on rotational transfer as well as the Inter Regional (State) Transfer Policy 
for the cadre of SSA issued vide circular No HRM IV/1(12)2012/KN/VOL II/16469 
dated 11.1.2019 (as amended from time to time), administrative circulars and 
guidelines of Vigilance Division as well as policy applicable to other Government 
Departments, other cadres and also the State Governments.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 2 
2.   Salient Features of the Policy 
2.1.     The fundamental premise of TP-SSA are fairness & transparency, and 
through it place the SSA Cadre equitably across different posts categories, offices 
and stations.  
2.2.     The TP-SSA aims to harmonise divergent objectives of institutional memory, 
avoid developing vested interest, exposure to different aspects of working in 
different post categories across various regions within the State for overall growth 
of SSA Cadre. It is paramount that career pathways of SSA Cadre is developed to 
fulfil the EPF Organisational goals. While observing the guidelines of DoP&T, the 
broad contours of organisational principles for career pathways of SSA cadre are 
laid out as under: - 
                 i.          The Nature of work can broadly be categorised into Three distinct 
Categories: Accounts, Administration and Compliance.  
Accounts Category shall include the work of SSAs / SSSA posted 
in Accounts, Cash and Pension sections.   
Establishment Category shall include SSA /SSSAs posted in sections 
like administration, legal, coordination, PAC, Facilitation Centre, DAK, 
Caretaker section, Grievance section and any other section that are not 
related to compliance machinery or settlement of claims.  
Compliance Category shall include Compliance, Recovery, Damages 
and any other sections that are related to the compliance machinery. 
                ii.          The SSA / SSSA   are expected to undertake within the service period 
different roles and responsibilities to evolve and mature into a Human Resource 
of value for discharging the various functions of field offices and grow into future 
progression roles for supervisory, enforcement and accounts cadres.  
              iii.          For the above, SSA/SSSA are expected to have served within a State 
at various District, Special State and  Regional Offices.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 3 
2.3.     While serving these roles, SSA cadre should also have an understanding of 
the diversity of geographies, industries and people they serve. Thus, tenures 
should expose them across the State they are assigned to.  
2.4.     SSA Cadre will also be undergoing various capacity building and training 
programmes to fulfil the organisational goals and prepare itself for future ready 
workforce. 
2.5.     All transfer and postings of SSA Cadre shall be effected by the Competent 
Authority in accordance with the instant TP-SSA.  The Competent Authority will be 
advised by the recommendatory body called “SSA Transfer Committee” (SSA-TC). 
2.6.     The SSA-TC will use a fair and technology enabled mechanism for prioritising 
transfers and drawing the list of SSA/SSSA with suitability remark for each transfer/ 
post / category.  
2.7.     A correct and complete database is a sine qua non for operationalising the 
TP-SSA along with a robust IT tool for an end to end computerisation of the entire 
process. HR of EPFO (HQ) as well as Zonal Office and Regional Office shall 
ensure that the database containing the complete placement profiles of all 
SSA/SSSA are regularly updated electronically and made available on Hrsoft. The 
IT Tool shall be harmonised with the criteria for assessing individual applications / 
Transfer as per the TP-SSA. 
2.8.     In case the number of SSA/SSSA are less in comparison to the sanctioned 
posts, the ACC Zone (In Charge of State) shall, in consultation with the ACC 
(Zones) & OICs of the Offices in the State, identify the posts that can be clubbed as 
additional charge with the post that are compulsorily required for the proper 
functioning of the concerned office. The compulsorily required posts and additional 
post thereto will be listed. No transfers or rotations will be undertaken on the 
clubbed posts.  
2.9.     Each ACC Zone (In Charge of State) before undertaking the exercise stated in 
the Para 2.8 shall fix the number of SSA/SSSA for each office on the basis of 
available workforce in his State and distribute proportionately as per claims being 
received by each office.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 4 
2.10. The transfer policy uses multiple factors to classify each post on the basis of 
Category, Tenure, Station, and Nature of the Post while also assessing suitability 
and Sensitivity. 
2.11. All postings are categorised under concept of Tenure (Time Span, 
Geography, Nature, and Category). Thus, a robust system of rotation will be 
followed based on the TP-SSA wherein, beyond a specific tenure SSA cadre will be 
transferred and rotated. 
2.12. All stations have been divided into three categories as per Government of 
India classification of cities for its employees for the purpose of House Rent 
Allowance (HRA).  Classification of an urban agglomeration, city, town or place will 
change as per Government instruction for the purpose of HRA without such 
changes being incorporated in the TP-SSA. 
2.13. All posts are divided into two categories, namely, Sensitive and Non-
Sensitive, as identified by CVO in conformity and as per CVC guidelines of 1999 
(as amended from time to time). The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) 
guidelines on tenure for and rotation between sensitive and non-sensitive posts and 
tenure in sensitive posts shall be strictly observed by the Competent Authority.  
2.14. All Annual General Transfer (AGT) and Inter-State Transfer (IST) orders shall 
be issued as per time schedules of this Policy. The other applications or vacancies 
arising during the period that is outside AGT/ IST will be screened on a regular 
basis to be decided by the Competent Authority. 
2.15. All grievances arising out of transfers shall be addressed in a time bound 
manner in accordance with the provisions of this TP-SSA. However, leave at credit 
of any kind as available may be sanctioned to enable the official to join new place 
of posting in case of IST. 
2.16. Composite Transfer Grant, Joining Time and other benefits pursuant to 
transfer shall not be admitted, in cases where request for transfer is made and the 
same is allowed except in case of tenure postings under AGT.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 5 
2.17. A SSA/SSSA transferred as per the TP-SSA norms on Inter State Transfer 
basis shall be eligible to apply for the various Limited Departmental Competitive 
Examinations in the various cadres only in his/her parent State where he/she holds 
his /her seniority/ lien. 
2.18. The AGT/ IST will have following numeric restrictions to maintain proper 
functioning and efficiency of the organisation: - 
2.18.1.                    For Inter State Transfers, the requests for transfer out from the 
State shall not exceed 5% of the sanctioned strength under Direct Recruitment 
quota of that State as on 31st March of that year.  
2.18.2.                    For IST, the total number of SSA to be transferred to a State shall 
not exceed 50% of the vacancies under Direct Recruitment quota in that State 
as on 31st March of that year. 
2.18.3.                    Any discretionary transfers on account of administrative grounds 
or exigencies beyond the TP-SSA norms of post Category, Tenure, Nature and 
Geography for AGT will be limited to 5% of the total transfers made. 
2.18.4.                     Similarly, the requests received from the SSA Cadre officials on 
account of compassionate grounds will also be dealt with restricted to 10% of 
the total transfers.  
3.   The Competent Authority 
3.1.     The Competent Authority for considering applications for transfer, placement 
or overstay and effecting all transfers and placement or disposing such application 
from an SSA shall be as under:

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 6 
3. 
RPFC (OIC) Regional Office  
Rotation transfer of SSA/SSSAs within the 
office as per norms of TP-SSA only. 
* In respect of North East Region, this shall refer to the ACC(Zone) of NER and for the rest, 
the same shall refer to the ACC(Zone) who is in Charge of the Political State concerned. 
3.2.     Notwithstanding the above, CPFC shall have full powers for transfer, rotation 
and IST of any SSA/SSSA.  
3.3.     The Competent Authority for making the transfer will duly secure the advice 
and consider the recommendations of SSA-TC and exercise its powers in 
accordance with the TP-SSA. 
3.4.     The SSA-TC will be a Three member Committee at the various levels  
 comprising as follows: 
3.4.1.    SSA-TC-Inter_State - At HQ Level- ACC (HR), Senior Most ACC at 
Headquarters and the RPFC-I (HR) as Convenor of the Committee.  
3.4.2.    SSA-TC–Zone - At Zonal Level - In case of Multi Zone State, it will 
comprise of  ACCs of the Zone and senior-most RPFC-I. In case of single Zone 
State, two senior-most RPFC I. In both the cases the convenor of the 
Committee shall be RPFC-I of Zonal Office/ RPFC I of nearest RO of the Zone. 
This Committee shall not include the ACC (Zone In Charge of State) 
3.4.3.    SSA-TC-Region - At Regional Office Level – comprising of OIC, 
RPFC/APFC (Admin) and senior most EO/AO of the Region  
3.5.     All instances where advice of the SSA-TC is not adhered to or rejected by the 
Competent Authority, the reasons in full shall be recorded for such decisions.  
4.   Tenure, Rotation and Classification of Geographies 
4.1.     For the purpose of AGT and rotation transfer within office, a tenure means 
continuous posting in a particular post (seat), after which an Official shall be liable 
for transfer.  The tenure for each category shall be two years.  
4.1.1.    Each SSA/SSSA in a block of three tenures within an office shall not be 
posted continuously in Accounts category.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 7 
4.1.2.    Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 2 continuous tenures in a 
District Office (maximum 4 years continuous service in a District Office). 
4.1.3.    Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 3 continuous tenures in a 
Regional Office (i.e. maximum 6 years continuous service in a Regional Office).  
4.1.4.    Each SSA/SSSA shall have a maximum of 6 tenures within the 
Jurisdiction of a particular Regional Office. (i.e. maximum 12 years in all the 
offices under the jurisdiction of a particular Regional Office.) 
4.1.5.    Each SSA/SSSA shall not have more than 8 continuous tenures in a 
Station (i.e maximum 16 years continuous service in a station/City). 
4.1.6.    It is advisable that SSA/SSSA should, for all round holistic 
development, do tenures at each of X, Y and Z category stations. The 
SSA/SSSA may be encouraged to apply for other category stations during AGT.  
4.2.     For the purpose of IST, following principles shall be followed:- 
4.2.1.    A tenure means continuous posting of two years in a particular post.   
4.2.2.    An SSA who has completed at least 4 tenures (eight years including 
period spent on probation) in the Parent State shall be eligible for applying for 
Inter State Transfer. Provided no vigilance case is pending against the applicant 
at the time of forwarding of request as well as issue of the transfer order of the 
official concerned. 
4.2.3.    The Competent Authority may grant relaxation in service period as 
prescribed above in respect of an SSA/SSSA where the request for the transfer 
has been made on the basis of prevalent DoP&T guidelines. 
4.2.4.    An SSA/SSSA can in her/his career in the cadre of SSA apply only once 
for IST.  
4.2.5.    Inter State Transfer will be on lien basis and for not more 3 Tenures (a 
period of 6 years).

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 8 
4.2.6.    The period may be further extended by Competent Authority (ACC (HQ) 
HR) on case to case basis by a period not exceeding 1 year. 
4.3.     The period of Tenure shall be counted from the date of joining and not from 
the date of the order.  
4.4.      Tenure of posting in North-Eastern Region (NER) and Andaman & Nicobar 
Islands shall be guided by the policy of Government of India on transfer and tenure 
for such places.  
4.5.     Posting of spouses/ Persons with Disability etc: Posting of spouses and 
persons with Disability/ Persons who are caregivers of Disabled Dependents etc 
shall be regulated as per Govt. of India policy on the matter as applicable from time 
to time.  
4.6.         The norms for transfer in respect of Officials due to retire within two years to 
the extent administratively feasible shall be guided by the norms of DoP&T. 
4.7.         All the above tenure, rotation norms shall be strictly adhered to unless in 
administrative exigencies and broader public interest requiring approval of the 
Competent Authority.   
5.    Transfer procedure: 
5.1.         The Transfers are categorised into two Categories of Annual General 
Transfers (AGT), Inter State Transfer (IST) and Transfers other than AGT (Non 
AGT).  
Annual General Transfers: - 
5.2.         AGT is defined as the annual exercise of examining the tenure and 
placement of SSA/SSSA and to order transfer or permit overstay of those who have 
completed tenures either on post category, station, geographies, or nature of the 
post tenure.  
5.3.         Transfer in pursuance to promotion shall not form part of the AGT.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 9 
5.4.         In case the number of SSA/SSSA are less in comparison to the sanctioned 
posts, the ACC Zone (In Charge of State) shall, in consultation with the ACC 
(Zones) & OICs of the Offices in the State, identify the posts that can be clubbed as 
additional charge with the post that are compulsorily required for the proper 
functioning of the concerned office. The compulsorily required posts and additional 
post thereto will be listed. No transfers or rotations will be undertaken on the 
clubbed posts. 
5.5.         Before options for AGT i.e. Inter Office transfer within a State are called, 
SSA-TC-Zone will undertake the following pre-AGT assessment and freeze the 
information: 
                 i.          Identify posts wherein the postings are to be made compulsorily for 
smooth functioning of the office. This shall be done category-wise and office wise 
in the State. 
                ii.          Identify posts that are under zone of consideration of transfer from 
Office and /OR Station based on the norms laid in Para 4 of TP-SSA and thus are 
available for AGT.  
              iii.          Prepare a list of SSA/SSSA who would be under consideration of AGT 
as per TP-SSA norms. 
              iv.          Develop a list of posts / stations available for transfers from the above 
set of information. 
5.6.         All options for transfer to an office shall be received through online-IT tool. 
An SSA/SSSA who is due for transfer shall be able to exercise option of five offices 
in the State within the norms of the TP-SSA.  
5.7.         Any SSA/SSSA who is seeking transfer, in relaxation of the policy (whether 
due for transfer or not) shall apply for an Office with the reasons and evidence 
thereof. These shall be accorded points as per the priority matrix under Annexure I. 
5.8.         SSA-TC-ZONE shall take the following action:-

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 10 
5.8.1.            For Compassionate transfers, SSA-TC-Zone shall, within the limit of 
10% of total transfers, take the topmost requests and tabulate on the basis of 
available offices and mark all applications as per priority matrix.  
5.8.2.            Thereafter each application will be categorised on the basis of first 
option. It will identify those Offices for which no options are received. 
5.8.3.            In case the number of options are higher than the number of vacancies 
for an office, a list will be prepared with following numeric rubric; 
i. 
First priority shall be given based on grounds of Disability. 
ii.   Second priority shall be given to those who are due to retire within 2 years. 
iii. 
Third priority to those whose requests are based on Spouses ground. 
iv. 
Fourth priority shall be given to options exercised by Female SSA/SSSA.  
v. 
Fifth priority shall be based on who has served the least period in  that 
category of station ( ‘X’ , ‘Y’ , ‘Z’) 
vi. 
In case of similarly placed officials, option shall be considered in the order 
of seniority with first preference to senior.  
vii. 
However, each such consideration shall be subject to suitability and 
sensitivity of that post. 
viii. 
For the offices and officials that are not considered after running the 
iteration of first options, similar exercise will be undertaken for second 
option, third option, fourth option and fifth option in that order.  
ix. 
For the offices and officials that are not considered after running the fifth 
iteration, the SSA-TC-Zone will examine over all profile and recommend 
them for transfers such that all posts are considered. While doing so SSA-
TC-Zone will try to accommodate the nearest of the available Offices given 
in any of the options.   
5.9.         Head Quarters will oversee an IT tool which supports categorisation of each 
post as per (i) Category (ii) Sensitivity (Vigilance Angle), (iii) locational and publish 
them for option calling.   
Rotation Transfers within the Regional Office:- 
5.10.     Rotation transfers are subset of AGT and shall be done after IST and AGT 
are undertaken. SSA-TC-REGION shall take the following actions;

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 11 
5.10.1.                    Before Intra Office rotation is done, SSA-TC-REGION will identify 
posts wherein the postings are to be made compulsorily for smooth functioning 
of the office. This shall be done category-wise. 
5.10.2.                    Identify posts that are under zone of consideration of rotation 
transfer from their current seats based on the norms laid in Para 4 of TP-SSA 
and thus are available for rotation transfer.  
5.10.3.                    Prepare a list of officials who would be under consideration of Intra 
Office Rotation as per TP-SSA norms. 
5.10.4.                    Develop a list of category wise posts available for rotation 
transfers from the above set of information. 
5.10.5.                    Recommend SSA/SSSA for each category of post taking into 
consideration the norms of the TP-SSA for posting within the Office among the 
three categories of posts, keeping in sensitivity (Vigilance Angle) for each 
category and administrative requirements. 
5.10.6.                    In case the number of Officials eligible for posting in a particular 
category is more than the number of posts available, the priority for shifting from 
Accounts shall be given over those of other categories. 
5.10.7.                    First priority should be given to an SSA/SSSA who has served the 
least period in that Category. 
5.10.8.                    An SSA/SSSA should not be allotted the same jurisdiction, 
specially in Accounts Category to the extent possible.  
5.11.     The above shall be prepared with the help of IT tool  as per various norms 
and parameters of the TP-SSA and the SSA-TC shall prepare the final 
recommendation to be submitted to the Competent Authority. 
5.12.     Each AGT shall consist of two lists of transferees: (a) SSA/SSSA who are 
due for transfer on completion of category / station / Geographical Tenure and (b) 
SSA/SSSA transferred on request / compassionate ground.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 12 
5.13.     When a certain number of SSA/SSSA are due for moving out of an Office / 
station to a new Office / station or to new postings in the same station for reason of 
having completed their tenure but cannot be so moved due to inadequate number 
of vacancies available at the destination station/office, the SSA/SSSA who has 
served for longer periods will be moved first. 
Inter State Transfers on Requests  
5.14.     Before options for Inter State Transfers are called, SSA-TC-INTER_STATE 
will undertake the following pre-IST assessment and freeze the information: 
                 i.          Identify number of posts available in each State for transfer-in as per 
TP-SSA Norms Office wise.  
                ii.          Identify the maximum number of SSA/SSSA who shall be considered 
for transfer out from each State in accordance with the TP-SSA norms. 
              iii.          Publish such information online for option calling through online Portal. 
              iv.          All options for transfer shall be for an office and shall be received 
through online-IT tool. An SSA/SSSA who requests for transfer shall be able to 
exercise option of five offices within the norms of the TP-SSA.  
               v.          The requests so submitted shall be routed through concerned OIC and 
ACC (Zone) through the Online Portal.  
              vi.          The concerned OIC at Regional Office shall take following actions on 
each request received:- 
a)    Verify the eligibility of the applicant as per the TP-SSA norms. If not 
eligible, even as per relaxation, shall reject the same with remarks. 
b)    Verify the documents uploaded from original. If wrong or incorrect 
document is uploaded, the same shall be returned to the SSA/SSSA for 
amendment / correction in request. 
c)     Upload the Vigilance Clearance Certificate / Status of the SSA/SSSA 
online

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 13 
d)     Forward the requests to ACC (Zone) with remarks/ recommendation if 
eligible and documents uploaded are verified from original with the 
Vigilance status. 
            vii.          The concerned ACC (ZONE) shall take following actions on each 
request forwarded by the OIC (RO) :- 
a)    May return to OIC (RO) for correct document upload; or 
b)    Reject the application with remarks; or  
c)     Forward the request to HQ with or without recommendations.  
5.15.     SSA-TC-INTER_STATE shall take the following actions :- 
                 i.          Prepare the list of candidates eligible for transfer out of the State from 
the total requests received from the State. Candidates not found eligible shall not 
be considered for transfer.   
                ii.          Arrange the list of candidates in the descending order of points 
obtained as per priority Matrix in ANNEXURE.  
              iii.          In case there is tie between applicants, the length of service in the 
 SSA cadre with reference to the date of appointment in the State shall be given 
priority and thereafter based on the seniority. 
              iv.          Finalise the list of SSA/SSSA based on above for transfer out limited to 
the total number of requests that can be considered for transfer out from that 
State as per Para 2.18. 
               v.          Thereafter the TP-SSA-INTER_STATE shall list all the first options on 
the matrix of offices state wise.  
              vi.          In case the number of options are higher than the number of vacancies 
for an office, prepare the list of options received for each office. 
            vii.          Such list to be arranged in the descending order as per the points 
obtained as per Priority Matrix. In case of similarly placed candidates, priority to

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 14 
be given to length of service and then to age with SSA/SSSA with longer service 
and born earlier given priority. 
           viii.          For the Officials that are not considered after running the iteration of 
first options similar exercise will be undertaken for second option, third option, 
fourth option and fifth option in that order.  
              ix.          For the SSA/SSA that are not considered after running the fifth 
iteration, the SSA-TC-INTER_STATE will examine over all profile and 
recommend them for the nearest available Office given in any of the options.

Transfers other than AGT & IST 
5.17.     Premature Transfers on Administrative Grounds 
           i.          In case of an Administrative Exigency the Competent Authority may 
transfer a SSA Cadre official without the recommendation of SSA-TC.  
         ii.           Any order for premature transfer shall be done by the Competent Authority 
for good and sufficient reasons to be recorded in writing. 
5.18.     Transfers on Requests within State 
           i.          Every application made for transfer, placement or overstay may be made 
directly to the Competent Authority through electronic medium. The same shall be 
referred to the SSA-TC and the SSA-TC shall submit its recommendations to the 
Competent Authority as per the policy guidelines. 
          ii.           The competent authority shall take action on the recommendations of 
SSA-TC-Zone within a reasonable period from the date of receipt of such 
application.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022)

5.19.     Postings on Promotion and Appointment 
           i.          The norm is posting on promotion that would entail mandatory change from 
the category of post where the official was working before promotion and if required 
change of office in case there is no option for change in category including change 
in Station.  
         ii.           Transfers on promotion shall be made by the Competent Authority as 
specified at Para 3. 
        iii.          SSA-TC shall examine the overall profile of Officials and to the extent 
possible within norms of Para 4 of TP-SSA, will give its recommendations for 
posting of each SSA/SSSA being promoted.  
6.      Redressal of Grievances:  
6.1.         Every SSA/SSSA aggrieved by an order of transfer has a right to make 
application before the Competent Authority within three days of issue of such order.  
6.2.         Grievance from a SSA/SSSA whose request for transfer is not heeded within 
reasonable time can also make such a request.  
6.3.         All such grievances shall be received online through HrSoft.  
6.4.         The Competent Authority shall refer all such grievances in respect of 
following instances:- 
6.4.1.            Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer 
by RPFC (OIC) – to RPFC/APFC (ADM) and two senior-most Group B 
officers posted in the office. 
6.4.2.            Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer 
by ACC (ZONE) (In Charge of State) – to two senior-most RPFC-I in 
the Zone. 
6.4.3.            Where grievance is against decision of transfer / no transfer 
by ACC (HQ HR) – to two senior-most ACCs in Head Office.

TP-SSA (12-12-2022) 
 
 17 
6.5.         The ACCs/ RPFCs as at Para 6.4, after taking considered view and 
subjecting it to suitability and sensitivity considerations, may advise the Competent 
Authority on the merits of the case.  
6.6.         The Competent Authority may on the basis on above advise and other 
administrative considerations dispose the grievance.  
6.7.         The decision of the Competent Authority shall be communicated to the 
concerned SSA/SSSA through HRSoft. 
6.8.         All such grievances outside AGT shall be disposed off in reasonable time 
frame normally not exceeding three months. 
6.9.         When an SSA/SSSA is transferred prematurely or in deviation from the TP-
SSA, he/she can prefer to represent or appeal before the Central Provident Fund 
Commissioner against such transfer who shall decide the representation.  
7.      Miscellaneous: 
7.1.         The basis of the recommendations in terms of norms and justifications used 
by SSA-TC shall be placed on the HrSoft.  
7.2.         All subsequent amendments to the TP-SSA shall be incorporated in this 
Policy and a consolidated Transfer Policy shall be duly published on the web site.  
7.3.         RPFC I (HRM) / RPFC I (ZONAL OFFICE) (STATE)/ RPFC (ADM) (RO) 
shall serve as nodal officer and shall be responsible to initiate the process of AGT 
as per timelines. The Nodal officer shall also be charged with the duty of seeking 
views of stakeholders regarding difficulties faced by them or improvements to be 
made to this Policy and to compile and refer such cases to Headquarters. 
7.4.         Residential Accommodation of the Board: Any transfer ordered in public 
interest beyond the schedule prescribed shall entitle the employee for the continued 
retention of the residential accommodation owned by the Board till the end of the 
financial year in which such transfer is ordered or till the period prescribed under 
Residence Rules applicable for the employees of the Board, whichever is later. 
Under exceptional circumstances relaxation to retain accommodation can be given 
by the Competent Authority.

7.5.         Power to remove difficulties: 
     i.          In case of any doubt regarding the provisions of the TP-SSA, the matter shall 
be placed before the CPFC for consideration. The decision of CPFC shall be final in 
regard to matters thus referred. The same shall be placed before the Central Board of 
Trustees in its next meeting for information. 
   ii.           In case of any difficulty in the implementation of the Policy that may be noticed, 
amendments may be recommended in the TP-SSA and placed before the Central 
Board for approval. Each such amendment of the Policy along with a consolidated 
Transfer Policy, after incorporating such changes, shall be formally notified and shall 
also be placed in the public domain.
